-from scipy.misc import comb
+# PORT: scipy.misc.comb was removed from scipy. math.comb is identical for
+# non-negative ints; scipy returned 0 for k<0, so the wrapper preserves that.
+from math import comb as _comb
+def comb(n, k, exact=False):
+    if k < 0 or n < 0 or k > n:
+        return 0
+    return _comb(n, k)
